Comment: M_diff = 12.3 computed as placebo mean (52.6) − nalfurafine mean (40.3) from the two explicitly reported week-4 means (simple two-arm between-subjects comparison); positive value favors nalfurafine. Negative M_diff favors difelikefalin (lower itch score).; unsupported or insufficient statistic type

Outcome measurement: LS mean change from baseline (SEM) per arm and LS mean difference vs placebo with 95% CI from mixed effects model with repeated measures

additional_group_ns: Individual dose arms subsumed in the pooled difelikefalin class: 0.5 µg/kg n=44, 1.0 µg/kg n=41, 1.5 µg/kg n=44 (reported separately in Table 2 but combined here per the review's one-class pooling rule)

Comment: CRITICAL: No numeric week-12 endpoint or change-from-baseline WI-NRS means/SDs/SEs are reported anywhere in the text or tables — Figure 2 presents the least-squares mean change point estimates graphically only. The only verbatim continuous WI-NRS values are the BASELINE means±SD (7.1±1.4 difelikefalin vs 7.3±1.6 placebo), recorded here for documentation; they are baseline, not endpoint or change scores, and must not be treated as the treatment effect.
